name: Matroid Flat Classes Are Not Conditioning-Closed
statement: A nonempty coordinate conditioning of a matroid flat class need not be a matroid flat class.
proof: Conditioning $\{00,11\}$ at the first coordinate to zero gives $\{0\}$ on a one-element ground set. Every matroid ground set is itself a flat, so a flat family on that ground set must contain $\{1\}$.
